title: Edgar Mitchell founds the Institute of Noetic Sciences
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Edgar Mitchell founds the Institute of Noetic Sciences, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell was a astronaut who'd been to the moon and into space at least and and he founded the Institute of netic Sciences of which I'm a fellow

plain: A biologist named Rupert Sheldrake tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who went to the moon, founded the Institute of Noetic Sciences in the United States, a group that studies consciousness and the mind. Sheldrake says he is himself a fellow of the institute, so he speaks of it from the inside.
